papers.title_en: SPADE-DFL: Communication-Efficient Decentralized Federated Learning via Derivative-Free Linearized ADMM
papers.authors: Mengli Wei, Mengkai Zhu, Jiawen Chen, Wenwu Yu, Duxin Che
papers.evidence: 通信高效的去中心化训练，减少邻居交换轮数
papers.tldr: 去中心化无导数学习中，多次本地更新会累积邻居间不一致并推高通信开销。SPADE-DFL 用原始-对偶线性化 ADMM，让本地函数值更新次数随计算预算增长，同时保持非私有收敛阶。非凸光滑设定下，以 Θ(T^{2/3}) 轮通信达到 O(T^{-1/3}) 的平稳性与一致性界；私有训练中每客户端每轮仅保护一个状态即可生成全部外发消息，并证明客户端级差分隐私。四个分类任务上平均测试精度优于现有去中心化方法。
papers.abstract_en: Reducing communication in derivative-free decentralized learning requires controlling the disagreement accumulated over multiple local updates. This paper develops SPADE-DFL, a primal--dual method that allows the number of local function-value updates between neighbor exchanges to grow with the computation budget while preserving the nonprivate convergence order. For smooth nonconvex objectives under uniform query-moment bounds, the prescribed nonprivate schedule achieves a time-averaged stationarity and consensus bound of $\mathcal{O}(T^{-1/3})$ using only $Θ(T^{2/3})$ communication rounds, where $T$ is the number of local updates per client. For private training, the accumulated data-dependent increment is isolated from the graph correction, allowing one protected state per client and round to generate all outgoing messages. We prove client-level differential privacy for the full interactive transcript and quantify the resulting optimization error over a finite horizon. Experiments on four classification tasks show that SPADE-DFL achieves higher mean test accuracy than existing decentralized learning methods.

papers.title_en: NSP: Accelerating Variable-Length LLM Training via Nested Sequence Parallelism
papers.authors: Yi'ou Wang, Xiaoyang Li, Yijie Zheng, Shouda Liu, Yuxuan Wang
papers.evidence: 分布式并行训练系统，解决通信与负载均衡的权衡
papers.tldr: 长尾语料下变长序列的 LLM 训练面临通信与负载均衡的权衡：单一序列并行度难以适配长度异质性。NSP 在单次迭代内把不同大小的序列并行组嵌套到共享 GPU 上，长序列用大组、短序列用小组，使通信只发生在必要处，并按 GPU 而非按组均衡负载。它通过树结构路由规划器在显存约束下分配序列，并用层间相位流式与树级重计算执行。在 Qwen3-MoE 上支持高达 384K 上下文，端到端训练吞吐较 Static SP 最高提升 1.48x，较 FlexSP 最高提升 1.16x。
papers.abstract_en: Long-context LLM training on long-tailed corpora faces a central communication--balance tradeoff. Such sequence-length heterogeneity makes any single sequence-parallelism (SP) degree a poor fit for the workload: a small degree leaves the few long sequences badly imbalanced, while a large degree forces the many short sequences that dominate the workload to pay excessive communication. Existing dynamic-SP systems mix SP degrees within a batch, but to run several groups at once they partition the GPUs into disjoint groups, which reintroduces imbalance across groups and forces costly micro-batch workarounds.   We present NSP, a sequence-parallel training system that resolves this tradeoff by nesting differently sized SP groups on shared GPUs within a single training iteration. This lets long sequences use larger SP groups while keeping short sequences on smaller ones, so communication is incurred only where needed and load is balanced per GPU rather than per group. NSP realizes this idea with a tree-structured routing planner that assigns sequences under memory constraints and an executor that exploits the resulting hierarchy through inter-level phase streaming and tree-level recomputation. NSP supports common SP backends and requires no model changes. We evaluate NSP on Qwen3-MoE workloads with up to 384K-token contexts across multiple long-tail datasets on an internal production GPU cluster. Across these settings, NSP consistently improves end-to-end training throughput, outperforming Static SP by up to 1.48x and FlexSP by up to 1.16x.

papers.authors: Josephine King, Ali Emre Balci, Raj Thilak Rajan
papers.evidence: 降低通信负担的分布式算法
papers.tldr: 多智能体系统中，高斯过程需分布式算法用本地测量与邻居通信维持统一模型。本文提出 ADMM-RGP 与 PDMM-RGP 两种分布式递归高斯过程算法，用于多输出回归。分析稳定性与收敛性，给出参数选择策略以加速收敛、降低通信。在真实多输出风电数据集上验证，二者在保持估计精度与全网共识的同时显著减少通信，且适应不同连通性通信图，较现有方法更资源高效。
papers.abstract_en: Gaussian processes (GPs) provide a flexible framework for learning unknown functions from noisy measurements while quantifying predictive uncertainty, making them well suited for estimation in multi-agent systems. However, when measurements are collected by multiple agents, maintaining a unified GP model without centralized processing requires efficient distributed algorithms that can operate using local measurements and communication with neighboring agents. In this work, we develop two distributed recursive GP (RGP) algorithms for multi-output GP regression: ADMM-RGP and PDMM-RGP. We analyze the stability and convergence of both algorithms and develop parameter selection strategies to accelerate convergence, thus reducing the communication burden. The proposed methods are validated on a real-world multi-output wind dataset, and their convergence behavior is examined across communication graphs with varying connectivity. Numerical experiments demonstrate that ADMM-RGP and PDMM-RGP can significantly reduce communication relative to the state of the art, while maintaining comparable estimation accuracy and network-wide consensus.

papers.title_en: ZO-COSMO: Index-Free One-Hop Mixing for Decentralized Zeroth-Order Optimization
papers.authors: Shengjun Zhang, Tingyi Liu, Heng Zhang, Dong Xie
papers.evidence: 稀疏通信去中心化优化，单跳混合
papers.tldr: 去中心化零阶学习中，稀疏通信要求对等节点状态坐标兼容，本文刻画这一单跳条件并提出 ZO-COSMO。该方法把两查询估计与保均值掩码共识耦合，每条活跃链路仅传 q 个值，并区分全局支撑与成对匹配更新。理论上给出匹配类内的收缩界及核心与稀疏动量收敛保证，实验在 64 个合成智能体与 8 个 Qwen LoRA 工作节点验证。在相同载荷下，Qwen2-7B QNLI 比显式索引 Rand-k 高 3.65 个点，边局部更新在完全图和环图上分别高 3.42 和 2.53 个点，为稀疏去中心化零阶优化提供无需索引的单跳混合机制与可验证增益。
papers.abstract_en: Sparse communication in decentralized zeroth-order learning requires compatible peer-state coordinates. We characterize this one-hop condition and develop \textsf{ZO-COSMO}, coupling two-query estimation with average-preserving masked consensus using $q$ values per active link. Global supports serve all-neighbor mixing; matching updates require agreement only within each pair. We derive a sharp contraction-per-scalar bound within the matching class and convergence guarantees for the core and sparse-momentum updates. At fixed matching, exact moment identities characterize how shared directions preserve gradient-heterogeneity cancellation and redistribute estimation error and disagreement. Mechanism experiments cover unequal curvatures, noise, and sparse momentum. Further tests span $64$ synthetic agents and eight logical Qwen LoRA workers. At matched payload budgets, Qwen2-7B QNLI gains $3.65$ accuracy points over explicit-index Rand-$k$; edge-local updates gain $3.42$ and $2.53$ points over all-neighbor mixing on eight-worker complete and ring graphs. A matched-first-step ablation gives a $3.92$-point momentum benefit. Seed-aware and same-matching controls distinguish encoding, scheduling, and query correlation.

papers.title_en: Scalable Subgraph Sampling via Resistance Curvature
papers.authors: Chaoqun Fei, Tinglve Zhou, Tianyong Hao, Yangyang Li
papers.evidence: 多GPU子图采样降低大规模GNN训练成本
papers.tldr: 大规模图神经网络训练成本高昂，子图采样可降本，但现有采样准则常忽略边的几何作用。本文提出基于电阻曲率的采样框架，核心是 ERC-LG：用 Johnson-Lindenstrauss 投影与正则化多 GPU 批量共轭梯度求解器近似曲率，避免显式计算拉普拉斯伪逆和存储全嵌入。曲率进一步指导节点与边采样概率，构建 GNN 训练子图。实验表明其曲率与伪逆法数值一致，运行时间低于仅用共轭梯度；在七个真实数据集中六个的下游节点分类取得最高平均准确率。
papers.abstract_en: Subgraph sampling reduces the training cost of large-scale graph neural networks, but sampling criteria may overlook the geometric roles of edges. We propose a resistance-curvature-guided sampling framework built on ERC-LG, a curvature approximation method for large-scale graphs. ERC-LG combines Johnson-Lindenstrauss projections with regularized multi-GPU batched conjugate gradient solvers, avoiding explicit Laplacian pseudoinverse computation and full embedding storage. The resulting curvature informs node- and edge-sampling probabilities for constructing GNN training subgraphs. Experiments show numerical agreement with pseudoinverse-based curvature and reduced runtime compared with CG-only computation. ERC-LG-based sampling variants achieve the highest mean accuracy on six of seven real-world datasets in downstream node classification.
